items.name: morluto/rea

Automated app behavior analysis for mobile app developers

items.name: openclaw/openclaw
items.one_liner: Versatile AI assistant for any platform

items.one_liner: AI agent that adapts and grows with users

AI-powered customer support chatbot for small businesses
AI-driven content creation tool for marketers

items.name: microsoft/vscode

items.name: open-webui/open-webui
items.one_liner: User-friendly AI interface supporting multiple models

Customizable AI assistant for personal productivity
Enterprise AI gateway for internal tools
